_note: Real typical fares go in "routes". Each fare is per person, one way, in INR. A route can list any of standard_bus, ac_bus, premium_bus, train, flight; a mode it leaves out falls back to the distance formula and is shown as an estimate (~). Set "estimated": true on a fare you are not sure of. A route matches in both directions. "aliases" maps one spelling of a city to another. "no_railhead" lists places with no railway station, so the train option is not offered to or from them.
